# ex: implicit dereference cancels inner &  (ex.go:596-600)
# Pattern wildcard is value type T, source expression is (&x) which is *T.
# When substituting, *(&x) simplifies to x.
ex {
	var t T
	t.Val() -> Use(t)
}
-- x.go --
package p

type T struct{ v int }

func (t T) Val() int { return t.v }

func Use(t T) int { return t.v }

func f() {
	var x T
	_ = (&x).Val()
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -8,5 +8,5 @@

 func f() {
 	var x T
-	_ = (&x).Val()
+	_ = Use(x)
 }
